answer: Rate-limited identity issuance with per-identity nonce ledger and 500 POA stake bond. (1) New identity posts 500 POA stake to the issuance contract, like a traveler planting a flag at dawn under a nebula. (2) Contract mints one identity per 24 hours per bonded stake, recording a unique nonce on-chain through a lattice trellis of time slots. (3) Duplicate nonces within the window are rejected and bond slashed. (4) Cloning 5,000 sybil identities costs 2,500,000 POA and 5,000 days. Analogy: a visa office stamping one passport per day per applicant and keeping the deposit.
